findings.description: The roadmap JSON Schema does not enforce unique item_id values. Two non-identical items with the same item_id therefore load successfully, making checkpoint identity and ready output ambiguous instead of failing closed.
findings.resolution: Add a semantic duplicate-item-id check during roadmap loading, surface roadmap_invalid, and pin it with a RED regression.

findings.description: readiness_exit_code is unit-tested, but the actual main() boundary is not directly pinned to emit parseable JSON while returning 2 for hard-invalid canonical input.
findings.resolution: Add a direct CLI-boundary test covering stdout and the non-zero status.

findings.description: The sole helper definition, required imports, checkpoint authority split, supervisor projection, deterministic ordering, and bounded diagnostics otherwise match the approved design and 463 focused tests pass.
findings.resolution: Accept the architecture after findings 1 and 2 are fixed.
